question: ________ is known as the cultivation of trees and shrubs.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arboriculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arboriculture** is the cultivation of trees and shrubs, which involves** planting, caring, and maintaining trees** and shrubs for various purposes such as landscaping, timber production, and conservation.
 
• **Arborists** are professionals who specialize in **arboriculture **and provide services such as** tree pruning, removal, and planting,** as well as diagnosing and treating** tree diseases and pests.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Viticulture **is the** cultivation of grapes** for wine production, and it involves planting and caring for grapevines, harvesting grapes, and making wine.
 
• **Aviculture **is the** breeding and raising of birds**, usually for pets or for commercial purposes such as egg or meat production.
 
• **Apiculture** is the **farming of bees for honey production, pollination**, and other bee products such as beeswax and royal jelly.
